title: Holdback where the Last Inspection Passed with Advisories
content:
A Keyturn Vehicle Listing whose most recent completed inspection passed with advisories carries a holdback, and how much of one turns on how much inspection interval the vehicle has left.

1. A vehicle whose most recent completed inspection passed with advisories and which has fewer than 1000 miles of inspection interval left carries a holdback of five hundredths (0.05).

2. A vehicle whose most recent completed inspection passed with advisories and which has 1000 miles or more of interval left carries a holdback of two hundredths (0.02).

3. Any other vehicle carries no holdback on this ground, a holdback rate of 0.

### Both sides of the figure

The split is at 1000 miles of interval left: 999 miles left carries five hundredths, 1000 miles left exactly carries two hundredths.

The advisory finding is read off the most recent completed inspection and off no other. A vehicle whose most recent completed inspection passed with nothing to note carries no holdback on this ground, even where an earlier inspection passed with advisories; and a vehicle whose most recent completed inspection passed with advisories carries one whatever the inspections before it found.
